problem: The Nyquist sentence is broken: 'the highest frequency present in that channel must stay below half its own sample rate: f_max Chapter 6.10.' A formula is missing and a chapter reference has been pasted into the sentence, so the student never sees the actual condition.
fix: To reconstruct a waveform, the highest frequency present in that channel must stay below half its own sample rate: f_max < f_ch / 2 (the Nyquist limit). See Chapter 6.10.

problem: It says the sample-and-hold 'removes aperture error'. It cannot: the aperture uncertainty belongs to the sample switch itself, and Section 3 and Q6 both say a changing input still gives an error of (rate of change) × (aperture time). The trap contradicts the chapter's own definition.
fix: Thinking the sample-and-hold improves resolution. It only holds the value steady. It cuts the smearing from the whole conversion time down to the much shorter aperture time, but it leaves both quantisation error and the residual aperture error unchanged.

problem: 'One comparator per code level' is loose: an n-bit flash converter needs one comparator per decision level, which is 2ⁿ − 1 comparators, not 2ⁿ.
fix: Flash: 2ⁿ − 1 comparators compare the input against every decision level at once, converting in a single step; fastest, expensive, used for video and radar.

problem: 'it doubles the resolution figure' is ambiguous — the reader cannot tell whether this refers to the wrong 5 V span or to the correct 10 V span, and which figure is doubled.
fix: Using 5 V as the span for a ±5 V range. The span is the difference between the limits, 10 V. Using 5 V by mistake gives ΔV half the true value, so the reported resolution is twice as fine as the hardware really is.

problem: 'Slow converters on fast signals make this compulsory.' is unclear about what 'this' is and in which direction the rule runs.
fix: A sample-and-hold is compulsory whenever a slow converter must read a signal that changes quickly during the conversion time.

problem: 'Three architectures carry these blocks into the field' comes straight after three converter architectures (SAR, flash, sigma-delta), so the reader briefly expects more converter types rather than system packaging.
fix: Three system architectures carry these blocks into the field.
